name: bollinger_ema_sar_v4_three_color_exit
purpose: Keep the latest crossover-derived non-lateral entry logic and change profit management to only three consecutive candles in the trade direction.

entry_logic_from_v3.structure: 2-left / 2-right confirmed swing; prior bar sweeps structure and signal reclaims
entry_logic_from_v3.pattern: rocket rejection wick >=70% of body OR body engulfing
entry_logic_from_v3.signal_shape: higher low LONG / lower high SHORT
entry_logic_from_v3.non_lateral: EMA3 and EMA9 both slope in trade direction on the closed signal bar while EMA3 crosses EMA9
entry_logic_from_v3.stop: low/high of candle immediately before signal
entry_logic_from_v3.ny_anchor: contextual only; never a hard time gate

single_change_v4_exit.profit_rule: Exit at the close of the third consecutive candle whose body color matches the trade direction.
single_change_v4_exit.ordering: stop is checked intrabar first; color-based profit exit is evaluated only at candle close
single_change_v4_exit.dataset_end: force close only for bookkeeping if a position remains open at the end of the research sample

comparison: Compare V4 with prior discovery variants on trade count, expectancy, PF, drawdown, LONG/SHORT, pattern, session, EMA9/20 phase, stop rate and three-color exit rate. No live promotion from discovery alone.
